description: Fetch data rows from one DATAcube table (cube_code + selections from slovakia-statistics.dataset_metadata — one value per dimension, supports single codes, comma lists, ranges, "lastN", and "*" wildcards). Returns one row per data point with each dimension's code + label and the value. Rows capped 1-1000 (default 200). Data: data.statistics.sk, no auth required.

cube_code.description: Table code from slovakia-statistics.dataset_search (e.g. "as1001rs" for "Population and attributes of age").

limit.description: Max data rows to return (1-1000, default 200).

offset.description: Number of data rows to skip, for paging through a large selection (default 0).

selections.description: One value per dimension of this table — get the dimension codes and valid value codes from slovakia-statistics.dataset_metadata first. Every dimension of the table must be present. Each value may be a single code ("2024"), a comma list ("2016,2017,2018"), a range ("2010:2015", "2010:", ":2015"), "lastN" (e.g. "last5" for the 5 most recent), or a "*" wildcard (e.g. "SK04*"). Example: {"as1001rs_rok": "2024", "as1001rs_ukaz": "UKAZ01", "as1001rs_poh": "TOTAL"}.

name: slovakia-statistics.series.dataset_data

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.
